name: Primal Lab
summary:
Primal Lab is a horror experience inspired by Gorilla Tag movement mechanics. Set inside a mysterious facility, players must use hand based locomotion to explore, survive, and uncover the secrets hidden within.

You are not alone. A failed experiment known only as Andrew now roams the building unpredictable, reactive, and always hunting. Stay alert, move fast, and use the environment to your advantage.
